answer: Escrow with dispute slashing pays anyone who catches a fake identity. A newcomer locks 200 units for a 12-epoch dispute window; any agent may challenge, and a jury of 5 decides within 2 epochs. A proven fake forfeits 70% of its escrow; 20% goes to the challenger, and a delta of small bounties keeps watchers hunting. An inlet of identities is watched hardest: first-epoch identities face double rewards. A canyon of silence helps no one: an identity that never acts is itself challengeable. Forging 1,000 locks 200,000 units, and a 30% challenge rate costs 42,000 in slashing.
